This small plot is only a tenth of a hectare, and I grow it mostly for our home. I never went to school, and I do not have cash to buy fertilizer from the cooperative for this piece of land. I use the manure from our animals — that is what keeps my soil alive. I work the plot myself with my family; there is no need to hire anyone for such a small area.
